fields.statement: At 2bf7d5e0, ran go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(hook-commands|describe-golden)$' -count=1: both PASS. hook-commands.txtar checks hook ls shows notify and event unset (text and --json source unset); after git config rhiza.notifyCommand it shows 'echo cfg (git config)'; with a live daemon started with --notify-command (state recorded in daemon.state.json) it shows 'echo flag (daemon flag)' with event still from git config; daemon status --json shows name/command/source of the recorded hooks and text status shows 'Hook notify: echo flag (daemon flag)'; after the daemon stops, config answers again.
